academySeminar.pattern: Instructor works on the same floor as the cadets; arguments move around case materials rather than staging the professor above them.

archiveReconstruction.pattern: Cadets physically occupy different sides of a route map or case table as they defend competing interpretations, then cross or regroup when new evidence changes the problem.

reliefHandoff.pattern: Cargo, tools, route data, or damaged infrastructure stays physically between helpers and recipients so the practical object of the argument remains visible.
